phase_name: Narrow Gate 8 through the selector, and forbid a narrowed run from writing a cache entry

objectives.description: Re-read gate8_run() and cache write/invalidate block before editing
Lazily source suite-selection-lib.sh from TARGET when GATE8_TOUCHED non-empty
Force gate8 onto GATE_DIRTY_LIST unconditionally when narrowed
Change only narrowed branch's pass() message
Extend narrowed branch's warn_advisory/fail remedy strings

approaches_tried.approach: GATE8_TOUCHED default declared beside GATE8_JOBS (after the arg-parsing while loop)
approaches_tried.reason: the post-loop default assignment runs AFTER the --gate8-touched case arm inside the loop, silently clobbering the value back to empty every time. Fixed by moving the default before the while loop, alongside GATES_FILTER/JOBS.

approaches_tried.approach: "${GATE8_ONLY_ARGS[@]:-}" to expand the possibly-empty --only args array
approaches_tried.reason: confirmed by direct reproduction that bash's :- default form substitutes ONE empty-string word for a zero-element array (argc=1), not zero words -- causing every unnarrowed run to pass a spurious empty argument to run-all.sh, which rejected it with exit 2. Fixed by using the bare "${GATE8_ONLY_ARGS[@]}" form (argc=0 for an empty array, confirmed safe under this file's set -uo pipefail on bash 5.3.9).

notes: Verification note: a full-battery (unnarrowed) --only-gate 8 run against the live repo right now intermittently exits 1 (e.g. test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh load-sensitivity, or test-gate-lock.sh's own fixtures inheriting the real GATE_MUTEX_HELD=1 this gate exports when run nested). Confirmed PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to this phase's changes by running the byte-identical, completely unmodified DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh (zero --gate8-touched references) under the identical invocation and observing the identical exit-1/FAIL output. The narrowed-side behavior this phase actually introduces was verified directly and cleanly: a mappable path narrows the battery and prints the narrowed pass/warn message with the narrowing named in its remedy text; an unmappable path falls back to the sentinel with a Note: line; the absent-flag path is untouched; and a clean narrowed run under --skip-unchanged leaves no gate8 cache entry (confirmed: specs/.gate-cache/gate8.json absent after a clean 3-suite narrowed PASS).
